About the Role Di Billstone, Anda akan memegang peran penting dalam menjaga kualitas dan keandalan proses keuangan perusahaan. Sebagai FAT Supervisor, Anda akan menjadi bagian dari tim yang memastikan financial process berjalan dengan baik, informasi yang dihasilkan dapat dipercaya, dan perusahaan memiliki pondasi keuangan yang kuat untuk terus berkembang. Your Responsibilities 1. Financial Reporting & Accounting Validation Menyiapkan dan mereview laporan keuangan bulanan dan tahunan berbasis PSAK, dengan laporan bulanan selesai sebelum tanggal 5 setiap bulannya. Memvalidasi seluruh transaksi, jurnal, rekonsiliasi bank, AR/AP, serta dokumen pendukung secara menyeluruh. Mengidentifikasi discrepancy atau ketidaksesuaian transaksi dan memastikan tindak lanjut hingga terselesaikan. Menyiapkan data dan dokumen pendukung untuk kebutuhan audit internal maupun eksternal. 2. Tax Planning, Compliance & Vendor Audit Memastikan perhitungan, pembayaran, dan pelaporan PPh/PPN dilakukan secara akurat dan tepat waktu, dengan pembayaran sebelum tanggal 10 dan pelaporan sebelum tanggal 20. Bekerja sama dengan penasihat atau konsultan pajak dalam menyusun strategi tax planning yang optimal. Memeriksa dan memastikan pemotongan pajak vendor dilakukan menggunakan tarif yang tepat dan sesuai dengan peraturan perpajakan yang berlaku. 3. Systems Optimization, Budgeting & Cost Control Mengawasi dan memaksimalkan penggunaan ERP, khususnya Odoo , serta software perpajakan seperti Coretax, untuk meningkatkan akurasi dan efisiensi proses. Memantau cash flow serta budget divisi dan perusahaan. Menjalankan cost management dan mengidentifikasi peluang efisiensi maupun cost saving. Menyusun financial analysis yang membantu manajemen memahami kondisi bisnis dan mengambil keputusan. How You Work Anda memiliki rasa tanggung jawab dan ownership yang tinggi terhadap pekerjaan. Anda teliti dan memahami bahwa detail kecil dalam proses keuangan dapat berdampak pada akurasi laporan dan kepatuhan perusahaan. Anda terbiasa bekerja dengan deadline yang ketat tanpa mengorbankan kualitas. Anda mampu menganalisis data, menemukan discrepancy, serta memastikan masalah ditindaklanjuti hingga selesai. Anda proaktif mencari cara untuk meningkatkan proses, sistem, dan financial control. Anda mampu berkomunikasi dengan jelas dan bekerja sama dengan internal team, management, auditor, maupun konsultan pajak. What You’ll Enjoy as Our Team Incentives (monthly & quarterly) Tenure rewards & annual reviews Recognition & appreciation culture Well-being perks Your ideas matter and are rewarded Qualifications Memahami secara mendalam PSAK dan peraturan perpajakan Indonesia, termasuk PPh Unifikasi, PPN, dan Coretax. Berpengalaman dalam pengawasan atau optimalisasi ERP, khususnya Odoo, serta software perpajakan. Memiliki pengalaman dalam AR/AP management, transaction validation, reconciliation, dan cost management. Terbiasa bekerja dengan deadline ketat dalam proses pelaporan keuangan dan perpajakan. Menguasai Microsoft Excel dan/atau Google Sheets tingkat lanjut. What Great Looks Like in This Role Accuracy & Deadline: Laporan keuangan tersaji secara akurat dan berbasis PSAK sesuai deadline, sementara pembayaran dan pelaporan pajak dilakukan sebelum jatuh tempo. Strong Tax Compliance: Seluruh pemotongan pajak vendor telah diverifikasi dan menggunakan tarif yang sesuai. Efficient Systems: Odoo dan alur perpajakan dimanfaatkan secara optimal sehingga data mudah dicari, ditelusuri, dan dimonitor. Better Cost Control: Potensi kebocoran anggaran dapat diidentifikasi dan diikuti dengan rekomendasi efisiensi yang dapat dijalankan. Reliable Financial Insight: Analisis keuangan yang dihasilkan membantu manajemen memahami kondisi bisnis dan mengambil keputusan dengan lebih baik.

About the Role VIDA verifies identity in real time for financial services, lending, telecommunications, and government-linked services. This makes us a target for organised fraud operations that spoof genuine users and devices at scale — and adapt within days when a defence starts working. Detection here is a continuing contest, and errors cost in both directions: missed fraud harms users and customers, while false positives deny real people access to services. You will own detection on this path: investigate attacks in raw device and behavioural telemetry, build the rules and ML models that catch them, and measure what they catch and what they cost genuine users. The data is high-dimensional and noisy, labels are scarce and delayed, and decisions must be explainable. What You Will Do Understand the adversary Investigate real attacks — reconstruct how a campaign operates from the evidence available, and characterise it well enough that we can act on it. Find signal in high-dimensional, messy data — work across large volumes of device and behavioural telemetry to identify what genuinely separates fraudulent activity from legitimate users. Keep pace with change — when an adversary adapts, quickly establish what changed and what still distinguishes them. Build detection that holds up Design detection logic and models — from feature engineering through training, calibration, and threshold selection, choosing the right tool for the problem: interpretable logic where explainability matters, models where they earn their place. Detect coordinated activity, not just single events — move detection beyond judging each request in isolation toward recognising organised behaviour across many, which is far harder for an adversary to disguise. Balance detection against user impact — treat the false-positive cost to genuine users as a first-class constraint, measured on the real population before anything is enforced. Own quality in production — validate before enforcement, monitor for drift and degradation, and know when to roll back. Make the evidence trustworthy Build and improve ground truth — establish reliable labels in a domain where they are scarce, delayed, and imperfect, and be clear about what your labels do and do not cover. Hold a high evidential bar — recall and false-positive rates measured on the right populations, class imbalance, selection bias, and correctness of point-in-time evaluation. You should be able to spot the ways an analysis can flatter itself, and design around them. Make the work reproducible and legible — analysis and specifications that colleagues can re-run, challenge, and build on. Partner closely with fraud operations, engineering, and product — and communicate findings clearly to non-specialists, including when the honest answer is uncomfortable. What We Are Looking For Must-have 4+ years of applied data science or machine learning in fraud, risk, abuse, trust & safety, security, or a closely adjacent adversarial domain — with work you took to production and measured. Strong SQL on large datasets — comfortable and effective in large, messy event data. Fluent Python data-science stack — pandas, scikit-learn, and gradient-boosted trees, with clean and reproducible analysis. Genuine evaluation rigour — you understand why a model can look excellent offline and fail in production: label leakage, selection bias, drift, class imbalance, and the difference between conditioned and population-level error rates. Feature engineering from raw, semi-structured data — turning noisy, high-cardinality inputs into signals that hold up over time. An adversarial mindset — you instinctively ask how someone would evade what you built, and you design accordingly. Sound judgement on explainability — decisions affecting a person's access to services need to be defensible, not just accurate. teks: About The Role This role is central to our Credit Risk Strategy for merchant lending products including Gopay Pinjam Modal (GPPM) and Toko Kapital. Key challenges include balancing portfolio growth with risk mitigation and navigating complex merchant data to inform actionable decisions. The person will be expected to assist in managing credit underwriting and account management. In order to support the deliverables, this person is also expected to quickly learn internal risk frameworks, establish relationships with key business stakeholders, and contribute to risk analysis and strategy execution. What You Will Do Monitor and analyze key merchant risk metrics to uncover underlying trends and provide actionable insights. Evaluate and optimize current credit risk policies to ensure robust portfolio health and risk mitigation. Leverage SQL and Python to analyze complex datasets, driving continuous strategy enhancements and executing them via decision engines. Partner with cross-functional business teams to guide and support data-driven lending decisions. Develop and maintain comprehensive risk dashboards to facilitate accurate, real-time reporting for stakeholders. Facilitate periodic credit reviews and internal audits to ensure compliance and uphold risk standards. Drive process improvement initiatives within the Credit Risk team to enhance overall operational efficiency. What You Will Need At least 3 years of experience in credit risk management. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Understanding of credit risk principles and lending products. Experience with data analysis tools (SQL/PYTHON, Excel, or BI tools). Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities. Attention to detail and strong organizational skills. Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks. About The Team As a pivotal member of the Credit Risk function, this role manages merchant lending products, monitors portfolio health, and ensures policy compliance. A central objective is to strategically balance business growth with risk mitigation through the interpretation of complex merchant data. We are growing rapidly, and as the exclusive partner of Flywheel in SEA, we offer many exciting opportunities to work with leading brands across multiple categories and key industry players. By joining us, you will work on the cutting edge of digital and social commerce in SEA, and experience what it takes to drive a successful ecommerce business end-to-end. The Role We are looking for a BA/DA — Social Commerce to become Intrepid's dedicated social commerce analytics subject-matter expert across the region, based in the Philippines, while acting as the go-to social commerce domain resource for country teams across all six SEA markets we operate in. This is a hybrid role by design. You will own social commerce analytics requirements end-to-end — discovering what country livestream, affiliate, and content teams actually need, translating it into a solvable data problem, and then doing the hands-on SQL, dashboard, and reconciliation work yourself, working hand-in-hand with our central Data Engineering and BI team (based in Vietnam and Indonesia) in a hub-and-spoke model. You are not a traditional, non-technical BA who hands off requirements and waits — nor a pure data analyst who builds what's asked without questioning it. The world is moving past the era of the static dashboard. Stakeholders no longer just want a chart to interpret — they want AI-native, proactive insight: analytics that surfaces what matters before anyone has to go looking for it, flags anomalies and drivers automatically, and arrives with a narrative and a recommendation attached, not just a number. In social commerce, that matters even more — a livestream session or a piece of content can succeed or fail in real time, and a report delivered the next morning is often a report delivered too late. We want this role to help lead that shift inside Intrepid's social commerce domain, not simply maintain the reporting model it's replacing. You will work directly with data flowing through Intrepid's socom platform, our internal system of record for livestream, affiliate, and content performance, as well as social commerce data crawled or pulled via official API from TikTok Shop, Shopee Live, and Lazada Live, and third-party market intelligence and digital shelf data. Data accuracy has been a real, active challenge for our dashboards; this role is central to closing that gap for the social commerce domain specifically — and to reimagining what social commerce reporting looks like once it isn't just a dashboard anymore. The role Turn business intent into requirements that engineers can build and QA can test. This is hands-on specification engineering. You report to the CEO and work with the CTO, QA, engineers and business counterparts. You own editorial precision. Changes to approved business meaning, scope or architecture go to the relevant business authority, the CEO or the CTO. This is not a product-owner or roadmap role. You will not own the roadmap, pricing or revenue targets. You will own the requirements: what the system must do, where each rule came from, who approved it, and how QA can prove it. Your first assignment is a fund management platform. If you are a senior Business Analyst, System Analyst, Requirements Engineer or technical Product Owner, and you value precision more than slide decks, this role is for you. What you will do Discovery and user understanding Plan and run stakeholder interviews, workflow discovery and user research to find goals, constraints, exceptions and unmet needs. Turn findings into clear problem statements, user journeys and priorities. Validate proposed flows and usability with intended users before they become build commitments. Requirements and decisions Write versioned requirements with an ID, source evidence, approval record, explicit dependencies and acceptance criteria that QA can turn into positive, negative and boundary cases. Turn ambiguity or contradiction into a decision request: the issue, the evidence, the decision owner, your proposed default and the requested action. Keep a decision ledger, so that no ruling stays informal. Keep scope, open questions and approved decisions visible to engineering and business stakeholders. Product design and delivery alignment Shape user flows, interaction requirements and usability acceptance criteria with engineering and business counterparts. Keep module boundaries and traceability current after approved semantic changes. Make the implementation impact visible before a boundary changes. QA and engineering handoff Give QA the exact approved revision, acceptance basis and dependencies before the affected build starts. Resolve or escalate the material testability gaps that QA returns. The affected build stays blocked until the gap is resolved or its approval owner excludes that scope. AI-enabled practice Use AI to draft and reconcile specifications. Check every AI-drafted clause against its source, and document your method. Improve the tools and templates that keep requirements, decisions and traceability easy to maintain, such as ID issuance, traceability and contradiction checks. What you need 5+ years of business analysis, specification engineering or product experience, delivering enterprise transactional or approval-driven systems from discovery through release. Strong user-research skills: you plan interviews and workflow observations, separate evidence from assumptions, and turn findings into user journeys and requirements. Practical UX understanding: clear navigation, interaction states, error recovery and accessibility. You can assess wireframes or prototypes and validate usability with intended users. Precise requirement writing and decision discipline. QA can test your acceptance criteria without asking what you meant. You read data models, API contracts and tests with engineers, and you reason about delivery trade-offs. Clear written and spoken Bahasa Indonesia and English, including facilitation of stakeholder reviews and decisions. Practical AI proficiency, with source verification and a documented method. Nice to have 7+ years of relevant experience. Financial-industry experience: fund management, custody, securities settlement, banking or payments. B2B delivery with a client-side sign-off chain. You have shipped a product built on a language model.

Health security – by 2033, national and selected subnational authorities have increased capacity for health security and animal health policy development, strategic planning and the assessment, mitigation and management of acute and emerging health threats. Job Summary This role will analyze commercial performance, evaluate campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and provide recommendations to drive growth, customer engagement, and profitability . Key Responsibilities Commercial performance analysis : monitor key metrics such as GMV, MTU, AOV, GM%, GP%, and other commercial KPIs; identify trends, gaps, opportunities, and risks. Campaign & promo monitoring : monitor campaign and promotion performance, including uptake, GMV contribution, basket composition, user segments, and margin impact; highlight issues and opportunities early. Cross-initiative impact analysis : assess the expected and actual impact of business initiatives on sales, customers, profitability, and other relevant metrics. Promotion scheme design : support the development of promotional mechanics by modeling their potential impact on GMV, MTU, GM%, and GP%; help define target customers, basket profiles, and promo economics. Post-campaign analysis : evaluate campaign effectiveness, identify whether growth was truly incremental or temporary, and assess customer retention, behavioral changes, and margin impact. Competitive & market monitoring : monitor competitor activities and market developments; turn findings into clear insights and recommendations for the business. Ad-hoc commercial analysis : support various strategic and operational business questions through timely, data-driven analysis and deep dives. Requirements Flexible and agile mindset : comfortable working beyond a fixed job scope and adapting to changing priorities as the business grows; willing to take on new challenges and contribute wherever analytical support is needed. 5+ years of experience in commercial analytics, business analytics, or another data-heavy role within e-commerce, retail, or consumer internet. Advanced Excel / Google Sheets and/or strong SQL skills , with the ability to build models, run scenario analysis, and turn data into structured insights. Strong understanding of e-commerce metrics such as GMV, MTU, AOV, GM%, GP%, funnel, cohort, and RFM, with the ability to understand what these metrics mean for business performance. Ability to design and evaluate promotional schemes , with an understanding of promo mechanics, margin impact, customer targeting, basket behavior, and incremental growth. Strong written and verbal communication skills , with the ability to explain analysis clearly and turn findings into practical business recommendations. Proficiency in using AI tools to support analysis, automate repetitive tasks, improve productivity, and solve problems more efficiently. Experience with BI and data visualization tools such as Metabase, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent will be huge advantage Good understanding of in-app funnels, user journeys, growth analytics, and customer behavior will be a plus

Role Overview We are looking for a Product Analyst Intern who brings a unique blend of analytical curiosity, data storytelling, and a design thinking/product mindset. Sitting at the intersection of product, engineering, and business strategy, you will help translate raw user behavior into intuitive self-serve dashboards, automated alerts, and compelling visual narratives. You can uniquely leverage your understanding of how users interact with layouts, hierarchies, and visual cues to transform complex metrics into decision-ready visual stories that help us build better features. Key Responsibilities Dashboard Design & Self-Serve BI: Design, layout, and maintain scalable, automated product dashboards (using tools like Google Data Studio, Tableau, Looker, or Power BI) prioritizing information architecture, visual hierarchy, and readability so stakeholders spot trends at a glance. User Journey Mapping & Behavioral Analysis: Apply user empathy to analyze behavior data (funnels, drop-offs, clicks) against the actual UI/UX design to find out where users face friction. Analytical Storytelling: Combine complex data tables with strong design fundamentals to produce high-context, narrative-driven analyses and charts that explain what happened and why. Experimentation & Deep Dives: Support A/B tests and cohort segmentations, ensuring visual changes on the app/website (colors, layouts, button placements) are clearly measured and visualized for cross-functional teams. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as a creative and analytical bridge between Product Management, UX Design, and Data Engineering teams to align on metric tracking and user experience. Qualifications & Requirements Currently pursuing or a recent graduate of a DKV (Desain Komunikasi Visual), Product Design (S.Ds), Interactive Design, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field. A strong product mindset with a passion for understanding app mechanics, user empathy, and why digital products succeed or fail. Deep knowledge of visual hierarchy, layout structuring, typography, and UI/UX principles. Familiarity with design and collaboration tools like Figma, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar platforms. Basic familiarity or an eager willingness to learn data tools (Excel/Google Sheets, SQL, or BI tools like Tableau/Data Studio). An analytical mindset—you naturally enjoy asking questions about user choices and behavioral flows. Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced collaborative environment. [Plus] basic familiarity with crafting UI/UX for banking or fintech key visuals or products.
